ranking_rule: descending finite cone-isolation score, then ascending candidate index

k3_selection_rule.triplet_order: minimize maximum pairwise cosine, then mean cosine, then maximize minimum and summed cone-isolation, then lexicographic indices

nested_extension_rule.candidate_pool: same top ceil(0.1 * n_finite) cone-isolated pool used by K=3
nested_extension_rule.greedy_order: minimize maximum cosine to selected support, then mean cosine, then maximize cone-isolation, then ranking position and candidate index

synthetic_contract.spatial_template: foreground-masked per-pixel channel L2 norm of frozen real B, normalized to foreground median 1
